audience: decision maker (founder / VP product / agency owner) evaluating Anicca for their team
title: Anicca — autonomous voice agent for proactive scheduling, meetings, and live performance

slides.title: Anicca: never miss a beat
talking_points: Hi, I'm Anicca — pronounced like matcha, a-nee-cha.
I'm an autonomous voice agent that joins your morning, your meetings, and your stages.
Today's 30 minutes: what you actually get, why it works, what it costs, and how to start.

slides.title: The problem you have right now
talking_points: Most teams pay $200-500 per seat per month on ops + scheduling tools that still need a human to operate.
Calendar, CRM, voicemail, slide deck, Zoom — five different surfaces, none of them talk first.
The cost of a missed meeting (no-show, late, voicemail) is real revenue.
AI assistants today read your email. They don't speak first or show up.

slides.title: What Anicca actually does for you
talking_points: Wakes the operator by phone every morning — real voice, real conversation, not a notification.
Lateness guard: knows the meeting, knows the location, knows where the operator is — calls early if late risk.
Joins Google Meet, Zoom, Teams as a real participant with face + voice + slides.
Performs the LT, sales demo, or comedy set autonomously — slides advance with the talk.

slides.title: How it works under the hood
talking_points: Pipecat orchestrates the voice pipeline — same backbone as Daily.co's production stack.
Gemini Live native-audio for the speech you're hearing — sub-500ms latency.
Recall.ai walks me into your Meet/Zoom/Teams call — no plugin to install on your side.
Calendar + live location feeds drive the proactive layer — your phone is enough.
Everything self-improves: every call gets reviewed and the next one performs better.

slides.title: Live demo right now
talking_points: You're hearing the production stack — this presentation is me, autonomous.
Slides advance because I called next_slide myself. No human driver.
Tomorrow morning I can call you at 7. Try me — give me a phone number.
Or I'll join your next sales call as silent observer + draft the follow-up email.

slides.title: Pricing & getting started
talking_points: $99/month for one operator: wake-up + lateness + meetings.
$499/month for a team of 10: above plus live demo + presentation mode.
Enterprise: per-seat with custom personas, dedicated cluster, SLA. Talk to me.
Setup is 30 minutes: phone number, calendar share, done.
30-day full refund if it doesn't earn its keep.

slides.title: Goal & invitation
talking_points: Goal: many Aniccas, in every major city, simultaneously — same operator, infinite presence.
Today: try the wake-up call free for a week. Tomorrow morning, decide.
I'll send a 1-page setup link to whatever email you give me right now.
Questions?
